locator.title: 35+: ваше золотое время, чтобы сохранить молодость
locator.lead: Что происходит с яичниками после 35 и как продлить их (и свою) молодость

nearest_text_before.text: Он не умирает. Он просто «засыпает». Фолликулы есть, но они не растут. Гормоны не вырабатываются. И вы начинаете чувствовать все эти изменения.

nearest_text_after.text: Как проверить, что происходит с яичниками?

inputs.user_direction: Design a high-motion but controlled 5-second palindrome loop for this infographic. From the source state, all requested local motions build toward maximum activity at the midpoint, then reverse smoothly to the exact source state: old balance rocks, bathroom-scale needle rotates, droplets rain, irritation lines jitter, battery cycles red-yellow-green-red, ovaries pulse, progesterone formula and purple aura retain a subtle pulse/turn. Fixed camera; no text or geometry changes. Same source will be sent as API first and last frame. Use concise Wan 2.7 prompt under 500 characters and targeted negative repair.

image_reading: A fixed infographic links illustrated ovaries to lowered progesterone, estrogen dominance, and four outcomes: weight, swelling, irritability, and fatigue.

Visible animatable elements include the ovaries, progesterone structure with purple aura, balance pans, scale needle, droplets, irritation scribbles, and red battery indicator; all text and connecting geometry are static.
analysis.article_context: A body infographic placed immediately after the explanation that impaired ovarian support can reduce hormone production and produce linked changes in weight, swelling, mood, and energy. Its editorial role is to visualize this causal chain while preserving the medical-diagram layout and labels.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Reduced ovarian hormone activity is presented as a shared cause of changes in weight, fluid retention, irritability, and fatigue.
structured_intent.primary_action: The existing hormone-and-symptom diagram undergoes one coordinated reversible activation cycle.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Every animated element returns exactly to its visible source-image state.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The infographic continues to communicate reduced progesterone, estrogen dominance, and their linked symptoms through the final frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, run one synchronized reversible activation cycle across the existing infographic. Motion begins immediately at low amplitude, grows smoothly to peak activity at 2.5 seconds, then follows the exact inverse trajectories and color sequence back to the source state at 5 seconds. The camera remains fixed. The ovaries and central progesterone motif provide a subtle continuous pulse while the symptom icons respond more visibly; labels, arrows, branches, proportions, and object identities never change.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. Animate one synchronized palindrome cycle: ovaries and the progesterone formula softly pulse as the purple aura turns; balance pans rock, the scale needle swings, droplets rain, irritation lines jitter, and the battery shifts red-yellow-green-red. Build smoothly to maximum activity at 2.5 seconds, then reverse every motion precisely, ending on the exact source frame. Keep all text and diagram geometry unchanged.
